what: Pressing the view button above the Work list adds is-grid to the list, and the cells slide from their current position and size to the new layout with GSAP Flip in .6s power2.out (cells are absolute while moving). Each press smoothly scrolls to the top — list with mixed 1·2·3 column widths ↔ grid of three chosen columns

options.class: Name added to and removed from the list, default is-grid
options.each: Late start per cell (s, from the first cell), default 0 — original faint-film is .03
options.delay: Time from press until the move starts (s), default 0
options.top: If false, pressing does not scroll back to the top
options.[data-fx-part=list]: List holding the cells — the two layouts are the consumer css list and list.is-grid

from.where: list.html Work list (original .work__toggle — after Flip.getState(.work__list, .work__item) toggles grid-view, Flip.from absolute .6s power2.out, scrollTo top smooth)

The index.html Grid ↔ Slider pill (original .p-home-view): after Flip.getState(.p-home-grid-mode__item), is-row switches a 4-column grid ↔ a single strip of 60svh cells, with Flip.from absolute 1.4s power2.inOut · stagger .03 · the Slider side delayed .3s. In the site copy the two buttons each send the layout to one side, and once it is a strip, 10000px of vertical scroll is tied to the horizontal movement. The motion part uses dur: 1.4.; ease: power2.inOut; each: .03
